description: Defines the class 'ru_dummy_sector' which implements a dummy sector for a radio unit (RU) in a 3GPP-like system. It handles downlink data, uplink requests, PRACH occasions, manages request buffers, and tracks metrics related to requests and late arrivals.

classes.name: ru_dummy_sector
classes.description: Implements a dummy radio unit sector handling downlink, uplink, and PRACH requests, with request buffering, late request detection, and metrics collection.

classes.name: request_information
classes.description: Template class managing request contexts, resources, and synchronization states for UL, DL, and PRACH requests.

methods.name: get_request_buffer_size
methods.description: Calculates buffer size based on downlink data margin, ensuring minimum size and divisibility by 10240.

methods.name: handle_dl_data
methods.description: Handles incoming downlink data, updates request buffer, and logs late requests.

methods.name: handle_prach_occasion
methods.description: Handles PRACH occasions, updates request buffer, and logs late requests.

methods.name: handle_new_uplink_slot
methods.description: Handles new uplink slot requests, updates buffer, and logs late requests.

methods.name: new_slot_boundary
methods.description: Processes slot boundary, retrieves and validates requests, and triggers notifications for uplink, downlink, and PRACH.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Resets stop control to start processing requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops request processing and waits for pending requests to clear.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Collects and reports request counters and late request counts.
